axioms.text: Airline earnings over a holiday weekend move with completed flights and load, not terminal dwell time.
If the buyer still wants the trip and flying is blocked, they drive: listed substitutes are rental cars.
Jet-fuel demand follows departures. Who pays the input (airlines) is not who sells it (energy).
A constraint already in the tape is weather. Only a verified change in the constraint is news.
Physical White House access is an input to live pool video, not to publishing text. CNN is a slice of WBD.
A consumer class complaint is not a finding. Day-1 listed impact is legal overhang, not tokens shipped.
Gemini is a slice of GOOGL. Claude/ChatGPT/Grok have no clean whole-company ticker.
A competitor not in the harm set wins relatively either legal outcome (unscathed rival).
If two labs race on the same scarce input, the input seller's sign does not follow who wins the race. A compute cap flips that.
Exchanges and brokers collect rent from being the only legal venue.
A business that exists only inside a time-limited exemption has renewal risk.
Synthetics are out of the TSV order; offshore HOOD-style tokens are not the approved product.
Nasdaq/NYSE/DTCC are already building tokenization rails; incumbent response can flip old-rent from down to mixed.
New supply at an oligopoly node hits incumbent sellers and helps buyers of cheaper output.
Sold-out tools are scarce add for the toolmaker, not extra wafers for the foundry.
A Nasdaq 10-Q delay is a governance print on the named issuer's sector, never Technology-by-exchange.
A ticker-less macro print trades the factor, never a name in the lede. Listed expressions are duration (QQQ/TLT), dollar (UUP), credit (HYG), risk (SPY), oil (XLE/USO).
Hawkish surprise (hot inflation/labor/growth, hike): duration and bonds down, dollar up, credit and SPX down. Dovish is the invert.
Fed-path color, speeches, hike-odds, and ahead-of are weather until the print or the decision is in the title.
A new tariff/risk shock is SPY down, TLT up, GLD up. Gold-on-Fed remains weather.
Oil factor is XLE/USO on a new supply decision (OPEC cut/boost), not a Hormuz reprint and not a random energy name.
